Name: Blue Grass Recolor Paths
Author: spiderbyhoshi
Description:
This includes recolours of the vanilla Stone Walkway and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12439]IdaIda's Grass Path[/url] and a brick path based on the one in the spouse area, all made to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]collingbe's Blue Grass Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].
The grass path replaces the gravel path and the brick path replaces the cobblestone path. Everything can be disabled in the config or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].
The grass path is made with fiber.

Downloads.Description: added earthy recolour, tweaked brick path
